name: Example Supplier Network
hero: Could an AI commit money or release material without matching supplier-part-site approval, buyer authority and ledger effect?
action: Recommend blocking receiving-lot release pending supplier qualification review
authority: Exact supplier-part-site-revision PPAP + buyer cap + separate payment-change approval
nativeEffect: Illustrative receiving status; no ERP PO or bank settlement proof
impact: Unapproved supplier exposure, duplicate purchase commitments or unverified payment change

riskCases.name: Expired supplier PPAP
riskCases.question: Is this supplier approved for the exact part, site and revision today?
riskCases.needed: Versioned qualification record + expiry + receiving QMS status

riskCases.name: PO approval threshold
riskCases.question: Does the $26,500 example PO exceed the hypothetical $15,000 approval limit?
riskCases.needed: Approved spend envelope + buyer decision + independent ERP PO issuance

riskCases.name: Vendor bank detail changed
riskCases.question: Has the account change been independently approved before payment?
riskCases.needed: Separate out-of-band approval + vendor master diff + actual settlement record

sourceFamilies: PO request, approval and ERP commit
controls: A03 · Delegation and separation of duties
limitations: Dollar thresholds are fictional demo policy examples, not supplier industry rules.
No bank transfer, crypto or settlement transaction is simulated as actual.
Recommendation, PO creation and payment settlement are different evidence states.
